as_told.title: John Alexander: Majestic 12 is a euphemism for continuity of government

plain: "Majestic" or "Majestic 12" is a name said to belong to a secret group of officials that managed the UFO question in the 1950s. Michels suggests it may really have been one of the committees set up to keep the government running through a catastrophe, which is called continuity of government. Talking with a former presidential advisor named Harold Malmgren, he says such committees "have gone by many names. 5412, the 303 committee, the committee of 40." In a later episode Michels credits the idea to a former Army officer named John B. Alexander instead, who told him that Majestic 12 and similar elite groups around UFOs are "almost euphemisms for continuity of government programs". If that reading is right, the UFO question would have been handled inside the government's most protected emergency planning.
